thread:
rachel: Dropped a fresh mock for the Billing page: 'clustered cards' that group workspaces by cost-center vs a dense "ledger" row view. Figma: https://figma.com/file/new-billing-2098 — need quick takes on invoice discovery & token breakdown UX.

diego: Clustered cards read well for execs. Ledger is much better for accountants who scan many lines. Main question: where do we put invoice download affordances so they're discoverable but not noisy?

kevin: Proposal: small quick-download icon in the cluster header + per-item ellipsis -> "Download latest invoice (CSV)". Add a bulk-select mode that reveals a FAB: "Download N invoices (CSV)". For >50 items, switch to async export and email link.

a11y-bot: Accessibility reminders: ensure download buttons have aria-labels like "Download invoice for <workspace> as CSV". FAB needs aria-label and visible focus ring. For selectable items, use proper checkbox inputs with associated labels and ensure they are in the tab order.

infra-bot: Backend constraints: immediate CSV generation ok for <=50 workspaces. For larger exports run an async job; estimated ~0.4s per workspace currently. Recommend gzipped CSV for big exports. Also suggest filename pattern: `redwood-invoices_<scope>_<start>_<end>.csv.gz`.

rachel: Good. UX nit: cluster headers will show a small total + tiny sparkline. Concern: rendering SVG sparklines per card caused jank in stress tests. Options?

kevin: Two options: 1) server-side rasterize tiny microcharts (8x32 PNG) and serve low-res images; 2) draw all microcharts to a single offscreen canvas on the client and blit per tile. Both avoid many DOM SVGs.

diego: Prefer server-side raster for consistency across clients and easier caching. Also makes SSR feeds lighter.

a11y-bot: Color contrast alert: the current subtle text color for the micro label fails AA at 12px. Use higher contrast token. Also if cards are navigable, implement role="grid" semantics and roving tabindex for arrow navigation.

kevin: Implementation notes for handoff: - Clustered view: CSS grid for clusters, cluster header has checkbox for bulk select within cluster, ellipsis menu for per-item actions. - Ledger view: semantic table with actions in last column. - Both views: lazy-load microcharts and prefetch images at low priority.

infra-bot: For exports >50 items, return 202 with job id and email on completion. Provide export history endpoint so UI can link to completed files. Recommend chunk size 20 and gzip payloads.

rachel: Copy tweaks: change "Download" -> "Download latest invoice (CSV)" and for bulk CTA: "Download invoices for selected workspaces (CSV)". Add helper text under FAB when disabled: "Select workspaces to enable bulk download".

diego: Keyboard shortcut suggestion: Press D to toggle select mode, Shift+D to trigger download. Make shortcuts discoverable in a small tooltip near the scope toggle.

a11y-bot: Shortcuts must be opt-in in settings and documented. When a scope change occurs (Org <-> Workspace), announce completion via aria-live polite and keep focus on the scope control.

kevin: One more perf detail: avoid on-the-fly token recalculation on page load. Precompute 7/30/90 aggregates server-side and include in usage API to keep front-end cheap.

rachel: Plan: I'll update Figma with cluster headers showing quick-download + microchart rasterized, ledger with inline actions, and add the FAB behavior. We'll test with 6 users (3 finance, 3 PMs) and run a perf test with 300 items. Thanks! :rocket:
